facts.business: The company has discontinued its manufacturing and trading operations; its principal assets are office premises and fixed deposits, and income is derived substantially from interest earned on fixed deposits.

auditor.name: Not stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter: 1) Material Uncertainty related to Going Concern - the company has discontinued operations and financial statements prepared on other than going concern basis. 2) Proposed Sale of Company's Office premises to a promoter group company (The New Great Eastern Spinning and Weaving Company Limited) for ₹51,500 thousand along with leave and license arrangement for 250 sq. ft. at ₹75 thousand monthly for 3 years.

key_risks: Interest rate risk due to income derived substantially from interest on fixed deposits
Fixed regulatory and listing compliance costs with no operating revenue
Going concern uncertainty as operations discontinued and financial statements prepared on non-going concern basis
Related party transaction for sale of office premises to promoter group company
facts.related_party_note: Sale of office premises admeasuring 1,340 sq. ft. at Jolly Bhavan No. 1, New Marine Lines, Mumbai to The New Great Eastern Spinning and Weaving Company Limited (a promoter group company) for ₹51,500 thousand, along with leave and license arrangement for 250 sq. ft. in same premises for 3 years at monthly fee of ₹75 thousand. Approved by Board on February 24, 2026 and shareholders through postal ballot (results declared March 31, 2026).
